vectors.reason: The delegation/proof JOIN (leaf-invoker === proof.did) fails ⇒ accountability fails closed

vectors.description: The accountable agent's chain, its leaf stating expirationDate 2026-06-30T00:00:00Z beside validUntil 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z
vectors.reason: A hop ends at the earliest end it states, so one past its expirationDate is refused whatever its validUntil says (delegation_expired)

vectors.description: The accountable agent's chain, its leaf's proof stating expires 2026-06-30T00:00:00Z beside validUntil 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z
vectors.reason: A proof past its expires no longer says its issuer delegated, so the hop is refused whatever its validUntil says (delegation_expired)

vectors.description: The accountable agent's chain signed, its leaf stating parentCredentialDigest sha256:1274bc3457f370ce9dcacb68a0a025cd9728d3280bec5a05793827f20f2b3b6b, the digest of the root. The root proofValue is 89 characters of multibase base58btc, which the digest reads as base64 characters
vectors.reason: A hop that states parentCredentialDigest commits to its parent, and this is the parent's SPEC §7.8 digest. An implementation that decodes the proofValue as base58 digests other bytes and refuses the chain

vectors.description: The signed leaf stating the digest of the root it was delegated under, presented under another root its issuer signed under the same id after revoking the first
vectors.reason: Every id and parent link matches, so only the digest tells the roots apart: a hop whose parentCredentialDigest is not the digest of the hop before it is refused (chain_invalid)

vectors.description: The signed chain, its root stating a parentCredentialDigest
vectors.reason: The root has no parent credential, so it states no parentCredentialDigest (chain_invalid)

vectors.description: The signed chain, its root stating parentCredentialDigest as null
vectors.reason: A member stated as null is stated: the root has no parent credential, so it states no parentCredentialDigest, null included (chain_invalid)

vectors.description: The signed chain, its leaf stating parentCredentialDigest as null
vectors.reason: A member stated as null is stated, and null is not the digest of the hop before it (chain_invalid). Only a hop that leaves the member out states none

vectors.description: The signed chain, its leaf stating no parentCredentialDigest
vectors.reason: A hop that states no parentCredentialDigest is not held to one in 1.x (SPEC §6.10)
